_approach: Built around a long, sliding 808 rather than a busy kit: a sparse kick anchors beat 1 and the & of beat 3 (tomLow layered underneath stands in for the 808's sustained low body), cowbell answers in short 2-note calls, hats almost absent so the slide has room to breathe. (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
